lines.en: : The most of what?! Do you have any idea what you’re doing right now?!
: Alas! I don’t! If only there was a teacher here to- ah! I’ve found one! Oh, I crack myself up.
: Am I interrupting, Mother? Should I step back out and come inside again?
: Oh! Tsukasa, dear. I was having so much fun I didn’t hear you enter.
: Akira and I were actually just discussing your education and how important it is that we prepare you for every aspect of life and not just the...academic parts. Isn’t that right, Akira?
: No. It’s not. That’s something you were talking about. Tsukasa doesn’t want to learn about this stuff from me.
: What stuff? I’m not really sure what’s going on right now. Was I supposed to have lessons today?
: You weren’t, no. But your tutor here was so concerned about your education that he came all the way over just to talk to me about it. Isn’t that kind of him?
: You really did that, Jeeves? Mother is very busy, you know. You should have just called me if you were that concerned.

: Without knowing what’s being discussed, however, I can not confirm nor deny whether or not I am comfortable learning something from Jeeves as I imagine there are a great deal of things I know more about than he does.
: We’re talking about the reproductive system, dear. Sex, if you will.
: Tsubasa...
: I don’t understand the concern, Akira. I’m right here to supervise the entire ordeal. What could possibly go wrong?
: Is this...really how we have to do this, Mother?
: See? Even she thinks it’s weird.
: Does Jeeves make you uncomfortable when it comes to this subject, Tsukasa?
: It’s not that I’m uncomfortable with it, Mother. Jeeves cares more about me than any other teacher I’ve ever had. It’s just...
: It’s, um...embarrassing when you’re here as well.
: Hah...
: Embarrassing? Why? I’ve sat in on plenty of your lessons in the past.
: Y...Yes! But this is...different. Isn’t it? And it’s...it’s not like I’m interested anyway! Just...somewhat curious is all.
: Well, this is as good a time as any to start asking questions, Tsukasa. Akira and I are both very busy people. And we won’t hold your curiosity against you.
: Just think of him as your father and I’m sure this entire process will feel all the more natural.
: It shouldn’t be too bad if you’re just answering questions. Right, Akira?
: Or perhaps you’d like to run to the restroom for a moment first to prevent the potential onset of any untimely distractions.
: Fine. I’ll answer your questions, Tsukasa. But let it be known that I am doing this under duress and your mother is just as capable of teaching you these things as me.
: In that case, I have several hundred questions that I have prepared in the event that something like this happens. Which order should I ask them in?
: Sorry — several hundred?
: Is that too many? How many am I allowed to ask?
: Whatever the bare minimum to satisfy your mother is.
: I’m quite easily satisfied, Akira. I’m sure you’d have no trouble at all.
: Just...go ahead, Tsukasa. Let’s get this over with.
: Then...what does it feel like? It’s good, right? Is that why boys cum?
: Yeah, Tsubasa — this is weird. There’s really no reason for me to be the one who does this even if you’re here.
: To be honest, Jeeves, I’m probably more comfortable learning about this from you than anyone.
: You are not helping right now. Your sister hasn’t even come to me with questions like this yet and she’s far closer to the age in which people normally learn about this stuff.
: Oh, what a splendid idea! I should have Touka join us as well. Then no one’s getting any unfair treatment!
: Please don’t.
: Touka? Can you come to my office as urgently as possible, please?
: As urgently as possible? Really?
: Of course. This is time-sensitive information. Tsukasa’s growing every single day.
: You wanted to see me, Mo-
: Wait, Sensei? Why are you here?
: We’re having an impromptu lesson on sexual education. So if you have any questions for Akira here, now is the time to ask them.
: Obviously Touka isn’t going to-
: Oh, excellent. I actually have over a hundred questions prepared if that is okay.
: Where did that second chair even come from?
: You have questions as well, Onee-sama? But you’re a teenager. Haven’t you already learned about this in school?
: I haven’t, no. Just the presentations we get here — which, as I’m sure you know, do not do a sufficient job of painting the whole picture.
: They are quite dated, aren’t they? How lucky we don’t need them anymore! Akira — go ahead and restate Tsukasa’s question so Touka can hear it too.
: Can’t. Forgot it already. Lesson’s over.
: It was just about how sex feels, Jeeves. And if the reason boys cum is because it's extraordinarily pleasurable.
: It is, yes. That much even I can answer. I would like to know how such a thing feels for the woman, though. But I imagine Mother’s perspective on that would make more sense to us than Sensei’s.
: Great. Then Tsubasa can answer.
: She can’t. She doesn’t remember.

: Oh! I know! Why not start by describing each step of the process? What causes it to get hard? How does it feel when it gets hard? And what about penetration? Is that the best part? I bet that’s the best part.
: There’s a clear best part and it’s not penetration. That answers Tsukasa’s question about cumming. Are we done now?
: Not yet! I have several hundred more if that’s okay.
: Question two — what’s a “blowjob?” Because I know you use your mouth, but it seems hard to have a penis in there and also blow at the same time.
: I believe the exhalation provides some sort of additional stimulation if I had to take a guess.
: You don’t actually blow on the penis. You’re not inflating a balloon. You just suck it.
: Oh, wow. I’m already learning so much.
: What does it taste like?
: How am I supposed to know? I’ve never put one in my mouth.
: Not even your own? Why? Is it not big enough?
: Tsukasa! That’s incredibly rude. I imagine it’s just unsanitary to do such a thing.
: But it’s not unsanitary to do it to other people? How does that work? You’re supposed to know more than me.
: Tsubasa...can I please go home now?
: Tsubasa?
: How long are men supposed to last on average?
: Mother?! Really?!
: What? Am I not allowed to ask questions? You girls aren’t the only ones curious about this kind of stuff. Let the record show that I’ve lived a mostly sheltered life as well.
: Do you not have sex with Father?
: I do not. But you never heard me say that, do you understand?
: I am sorry.
: Why not? Do you two not love each other anymore?
: Of course we do, dear. But sex doesn’t always have to be about love. Sometimes, two people are just attracted to each other and want to make each other feel good.
: I see...
: Why not do it with Jeeves then?
: I’m sorry?
: Ts...Tsukasa! That’s adultery! Mother can’t do such a thing while she’s married to Father!
: Fine. Then why don’t you do it, Onee-sama? You’re not dating anyone.
: That’s somehow even worse!
: Ugh, fine. Then you two leave me no choice. I’ll do it.
: Only if Jeeves is okay with it, though. I’ve read that consent is very important when it comes to sexual intercourse.
: Um...no? Ew? Gross? Grow up?
: Is that something you actually want to do, Tsukasa?
: Um, Mother?! Hello?! She’s a-
: In a moment, Touka. I’m talking to your sister right now.
: I don’t know what I want. I don’t know what I’m supposed to want.
: Because if you don’t have sex and Onee-sama doesn’t have sex, what age am I supposed to be before I start doing it?
: Old enough to live on your own at least.
: We’re in the clear then, Jeeves! I have an apartment! We’re gonna need to keep it down though since I’ve heard how loud that kind of stuff can get.
: I will take that apartment away from you if you’re going to use it for things like that! I meant you must be old enough to buy one! Not have one gifted to you!
: What do you think about this, Akira?
: The same way I felt thirty minutes ago — that I shouldn’t be here and this is weird.
: Because it’s me?...
: Yes, but in whatever way is going to hurt your pride the least.
: Sensei, with all due respect, I think this is the perfect moment to hurt Tsukasa’s pride as it has clearly gone out of control.
: Now, now. The reason we’re doing this at all is for Tsukasa’s sake, dear. She’s very confused and is relying on us to guide her.
: If you take advantage of her vulnerability to insult her, all it will do is make her lash out in the end. This is the exact moment we should be taking her interest to heart.
: But Mother...her interest is having sex with Sensei. Are you not going to put your foot down?
: What she wants is a live demonstration, dear. That’s why she asked us first.
: Invite Chinami’s sister over if you have to! Jeeves does it with her all the time, but she won’t even let us stay in the room for it!
: Well, at least someone I know isn’t outright insane.
: Is there a reason you want to see such a thing up close, Tsukasa? Does a Q&A not suffice to satisfy your curiosities?
: Not while you two are in the room...I have a million questions for Jeeves and it’s just confusing with everybody else grabbing his attention. It’s clearly overwhelming him.
: You’re right. It’s clearly that that’s making him uncomfortable.
: Why don’t you do it then? You’re the most logical pairing for a live demonstration, darling.
: Because that’s crazy! You’re being way too casual about this! I don’t want to have my first time in the same room as my family! Have you gone mad?!
: Hah...okay. Looks like it’ll have to be me after all then.
: Fine! You won’t put your foot down?! I will instead!
: Come on, Sensei. We’re leaving.
: Ah! Mother! Stop them! Onee-sama is going to go have sex with Jeeves in private! This is not conducive to a proper learning environment!
: The lesson will have to wait, dear. We should let your sister have sex with her teacher in whatever environment makes her feel most comfortable.
: We will do no such thing! I just don’t want you two badgering him into committing heinous acts for the sake of your education!
: You also had a notebook until like five seconds ago.
: Being curious is not a sin and I shan’t be judged for it! I know when enough is enough!
: The two of you, though...
: This man is not your plaything. He’s an intelligent, creative, and kind human being who desperately wants to be better. And you’re only making that harder for him.
: Is Akira kind? I’ve never noticed.
: He’s nice to me. And very nice to Chinami’s sister. She was loud.
: Oh, I’ve heard. That girl is well taken care of.
: Disgusting...
: Utterly disgusting...
: Thanks for getting me out of there, but...do you really need to keep pulling my hand? I can make it on my own from here.
: If I let go, I risk one of them snatching you up and taking you God knows where to do God knows what. I’ll keep my hand right there, thank you very much.
: Just so we’re on the same page here, I really didn’t have much to do with that. Your mom just decided that-
: I am better off not knowing the details. They’ll only make me angrier.
: Touka-
: Jeeves! Onee-sama! Wait for me!
: Hah...how quickly can you run?
: Tsukasa’s not the one you want to be mad at, Touka. We should at least hear her out.
: I apologize, Sensei — but I find it hard to not be mad at a girl who openly wishes to cuckold me, sister or not.
: She doesn’t know what she’s doing. She’s confused and she’s like that because of me.
: Yes, and so am I. But you don’t see me trying to sleep with you in front of my mother.
: Guys! Wait! Please!
: Hah...
: I am going to regret this...
: Hah...hah...hah!
: I’ve never had to...run that fast...for anything...in my life!
: Did I do...something wrong?! What...was it?! Tell me...and I’ll...do better...next time!
: Tsukasa-
: I really want...to learn!...I don’t...want to be...useless anymore!
: You’re not useless, Tsukasa...
: But...I am! Onee-sama is...the heir! Mother is...Mother! And I’m just...a tool! Which is fine! That part...is fine!
: But if I am...to be a tool...I at least...want to be a good one! I want to know...the things adults know! I want to do...the things adults do!
: I want to...grow up now! So I can see this world...the way you can! Before I’m not a part of it anymore!
: I’m sorry about Mother too! I wanted to keep her out of this! But I was going to ask you either way, Jeeves! Because you’re the only one who can teach me!
: Oh, joy. The man I like is the only one who can teach my little sister about sex. I’ll be damned if this isn’t the start of a pornographic film somewhere.
: Tsukasa...I know why you’re trying to rush this whole “growing up” thing...and that’s what I’m trying to fix right now. This all started because of that.
: Wait...since when do you know about-
: Don’t interfere, Jeeves.
: This is the one chance I’ve ever had to do something good for this family.
: If you take that from me, I will never forgive you.
: That sounds better than never being able to forgive myself for not trying.
: Why would you?...
: Why are you nice to me at all? You have no reason to be. I don’t understand.
: I just know what it’s like to be rescued at your age. And the idea of being on the opposite end of that is too good to shy away from.
: That’s why I’ve done this before — taken someone under my wing when the safer thing to do would be to just push them out of the nest and let them figure things out on their own.
: Not all wings are made equally. Some are much sharper than others. Do you know what I mean, Tsukasa?
: Sensei...I think you should leave now.
: Yeah...
: I think you’re right.
Touka escorts me to the gate while Tsukasa remains in place, watching with tears in her eyes as I fade from her view.
But I will be back.
Whether I want to be or not.
And I will slice up one more fledgling so badly that it will have no choice but to return to its nest forever.
Tsubasa’s affection has increased by 5!
Tsukasa’s affection has increased by 10!
